{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in 'site' to confirm the number of sites
print(trial_df['site'].unique())

# Check the value counts for 'site' to see distribution across sites
print('\nSite distribution:')
print(trial_df['site'].value_counts())

# Check the value counts for 'responded' to understand response outcome
print('\nResponse distribution:')
print(trial_df['responded'].value_counts())

# Calculate response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rate by site:')
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
max_response_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
max_response_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f'\nSite with highest response rate: {max_response_site} ({max_response_rate:.3f})')"}
